title: Quietly Garlicky Turkish Sun-Dried Tomatoes Pilaf
description: A garlicky, creamy, and festive Turkish dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes and confit tomato, friendly to ayurvedic-rajasic diets. This pilaf is perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, for 4 minutes.
Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
Add the basmati rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the confit tomato.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
